'''S3-E3''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] programming belonging to [[Celestra]], an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as part of the [[Republic Corps of Engineers/Legends|Republic Corps of Engineers]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during part of the war, where he aided Celestra and the [[Republic Army]] against the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] in the [[Separatist War]].

==Biography==
S3-E3 was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] with [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] programming who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the Republic. During the war he worked with the [[Republic Corps of Engineers/Legends|Republic Corps of Engineers]], a branch of the army that specialized in mechanical maintenance. Near the end of the war, a detachment of the Corps was deployed on the Republic-held [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]<ref name="Generator Problems" /> in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="NEPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>. Whilst stationed on the planet, he and all Republic forces aided the corrupt local government in fighting the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]].<ref name="Generator Problems" />

On Ord Mantell, S3-E3 worked with the [[Human/Legends|human]] corpsman [[Celestra]], who was stationed in the Republic stronghold of [[Fort Garnik]]. The duo, along with several other [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] were sent to repair one of Garnik's external power generators which had been sabotaged by Separatists. However, the team was attacked by Separatists, and all but Celestra and S3-E3 were killed. S3-E3 fled into the [[Avilatan Badlands]], while Celestra remained behind to defend the generator. There the droid waited by a road for any aid to pass by.<ref name="Generator Problems" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Eventually, a Republic-allied individual encountered the droid, and S3-E3 begged the individual to save Celestra and help fix the generator in order to save many lives at Fort Garnik. Agreeing, the operative successfully rescued Celestra and aided in repairing the generator by recovering her tools while she kept it stable.<ref name="Generator Problems" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
S3-N3 is a non-player character from the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He is involved in a single quest, "Generator Problems," available to players of the [[Trooper/Legends|Trooper]] or [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] class on their starting [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. It is not possible for players of the Imperial faction to interact with S3-E3 as there is currently no way Imperial characters can travel to Ord Mantell.<ref name="Generator Problems" />
